meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 第一次用 omo 时,Claude 当向导,带你依次走功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值估算、记忆记录和首次 init-deep 提议,其中三项由你决定是否参与,并全程用你的语言回应。
howto.when: 当你作为新用户提出想上手 omo 时自动启动,全程只自动启动一次;之后可用 `omo --onboard` 把它叫回来,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 我是新用户,带我上手 omo
say.note: 会按六个环节依次引导你。

say.text: 帮我从 Claude Code 迁移配置过来
say.note: 先给出迁移计划,等你确认再动手。

say.text: 看看我以前的会话,估一下能省多少
say.note: 读取本地会话日志并给出估算。

howto.what_en: On a first omo run, Claude guides you through six lanes in order: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording and the first init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in, and it replies in your language.
howto.when_en: Auto-starts once, ever, when a new user asks to get started with omo. It comes back later via the `--onboard` flag, or auto-start is turned off with the onboarding-disabled flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo - walk me through getting started
Carry my Claude Code setup over to omo
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan, waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Look at my old sessions and estimate the savings
say_en.note: Reads local session logs, computes an estimate.
